description: PTV Viswalk provides microscopic pedestrian simulation using a social-force model to assess movement, waiting, queues, passage widths and evacuation. The provider is PTV Group. Geographical and temporal coverage: The software is intended for user-defined stations, airports, buildings and event venues; no fixed geographical or temporal coverage applies. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is commercial licensing; exact terms require provider confirmation. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-ptv-vissim, model-ptv-visum, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
